exam.title: Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure
exam.description: Passing this exam earns you the Cisco Certified Specialist - Data Center ACI Implementation certification, and can also be used to meet the concentration exam requirements for the Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Data Center certification. Passing this exam also can be used towards your recertification goals. Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (300-620 DCACI) v1.1 is a 90-minute exam that certifies a candidate's knowledge of Cisco switches in Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) mode, including configuration, implementation, and management.

question.description: An engineer is configuring router R2 in autonomous system 65002 to control the propagation of the prefix 192.0.2.0/24, which R2 learns from router R1 via an eBGP session. The engineer applies an inbound route map that sets the well-known community NO_ADVERTISE on this prefix. R2 has three fully established iBGP peers inside AS 65002 and one additional eBGP peer in AS 65003. Assuming no other filtering is configured, to which peers will R2 advertise the 192.0.2.0/24 prefix?

options.option: All iBGP and eBGP peers, because NO_ADVERTISE only prevents the prefix from being readvertised toward the originating AS
The eBGP peer in AS 65003 only
All iBGP and eBGP peers, but with the community attribute stripped from the updates
No BGP peers at all; the prefix remains in R2's local BGP table but is not advertised to any peer
No BGP peers at all; the prefix remains in R2's local BGP table but is not advertised to any peer

question.description: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure an L3Out peering with the backbone network. The L3Out must forward unicast and multicast traffic over the link. Which two methods should be used to configure L3Out to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

An engineer deploys a Cisco ACI fabric. The engineer created a VPC policy group named Allot_MET_RIO7_RIO8 for the enclosure and these objects have been configured: • Physical Domain Bare_Metal_L3In_Dom • VLAN pool NFVI_VLPool • AAEP NFVI_AAEP Drag and drop objects from the left to the objects under which they must be added to configure an EPG named 12_MSSMET2_LDE_int_EPG.
